name: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72

sources.title: ModulEdge: GB300 NVL72, what one rack demands
Data Gravity: How much does an NVIDIA NVL72 cost?
PC Games Hardware: Vera Rubin NVL72 rack price (Morgan Stanley estimate)

summary: 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs and 36 Grace CPUs in one 48U MGX rack: 18 compute trays, 9 NVLink switch trays, 8 power shelves feeding a 50 to 54 V DC busbar. About 85 to 90% of the heat goes to liquid; the rest needs air.

nominalPowerW.note: HPE QuickSpecs (a50009244enw) give 132 kW nominal TDP; the hpe.com page timed out, so ModulEdge's restatement is cited. ModulEdge's own planning figure is up to 142 kW.

peakPowerW.note: EDPp about 155 kW per HPE QuickSpecs, as restated by ModulEdge. HPE advises provisioning busway for 192 kW.

weightKg.note: Approximately 1,580 kg, depending on the configuration.

depthMm.note: 1,068 mm rack, expanding to 1,200 mm with the extension frame. The footprint uses 1,200 mm.

maxLiquidFraction.note: ModulEdge reports Lenovo's split as roughly 90% liquid, 10% air. Integrators commonly quote 85 to 90%; the low end is used so the air side is not undersized.

maxCoolantSupplyC.note: ASHRAE W45. Lenovo lists operating water at 2 to 50 °C but publishes flow and pressure drop only up to 45 °C supply (177 L/min, 18.4 psi).

fp8Pflops.note: Dense. NVIDIA lists 720 PFLOPS FP8 with sparsity per rack; dense is half.

capexUsd.note: No list price. Data Gravity reports small-order POs just under $5.0M without an in-rack CDU; Morgan Stanley's bill-of-materials estimate (via PC Games Hardware) is about $4M for hyperscalers. Midpoint used.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Shipping product, but allocation-constrained. Assumed 12 to 26 weeks from PO to delivery, depending on buyer volume and ODM.
